## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `4a036ae8d4471f771cd94f6d5730710f4cf77ebc`
Local-runs: none

Isolated review of PR objectui#12469 for card objectui#12461, from the card and every comment on it, the PR body, its file list and the net diff against `main` at the head, and the head's check-runs. The served tier is the one the recogniser maps this file list to: no published-schema path and no governed path among the eighteen files, so the declaration face (`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --face declaration`); the brief named the contract-review tier, and that name does not stand on this face. Check-runs read at 2026-10-15T10:53Z: 37 runs, all `completed`; every conclusion `success` except three `skipped` by design (`Test (coverage)`, its shard matrix, `dependabot`) and one `failure`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, read in ③.

### ① Derived judgments

Read from each package's `exports` map and entry at the head; neither `package.json` is in the diff.

1. **`@object-ui/i18n` narrows, and RIGHT to do so.** `topbar.switchObject` leaves all ten packs, one line each, with no key added or renamed. It is published three ways: the `./locales/*` subpath (each pack's own `.js` and `.d.ts`), the `./locales` barrel (`builtInLocales` and the ten re-exports) and the root entry (`en`, and `TranslationKeys`, which is `typeof en`); `@object-ui/react` re-exports `TranslationKeys` from its own entry. Value face: a lookup now gets the key string back, as the changeset says. Type face: `TranslationKeys['topbar']` loses the member; no `t` in the tree is typed by it (`TranslateFn` takes `key: string`, and no i18next `CustomTypeOptions` augmentation exists), so only a consumer indexing the type itself is reached. Readers: the 「Switch Object」 menu was the key's one reader; at the head a tree-wide grep finds the changeset alone (`switchObjectMode` in `AppNavInspector` is an unrelated identifier); the sibling objectstack checkout at `086fa4640` reads neither the key nor the removed test id. Precedent objectui#12273 (PR objectui#12279) retired two pack keys the same way. The changeset's BREAKING note names the originating package, as the precedent's did; naming the `TranslationKeys` type and the `@object-ui/react` re-export would be stricter, and is not owed.
2. **`@object-ui/app-shell` adds, removes or renames no export, prop or option: RIGHT.** `src/index.ts`, `package.json` and its `exports` map are untouched; `AppHeaderProps` is untouched, no hunk reaches its eight members. `urlParams` keeps `decodeRecordTrail`, `buildRecordTrailHref` and `RECORD_TRAIL_PARAM` exported, still read by `RecordDetailView`. The published `AppHeader` changes BEHAVIOUR, each change named in the changeset: an object route (list, view, record, the `?from=` trail included) draws no crumb from `sm` up and no 「Switch Object」 menu; the PREVIEW chip sits right after the pill in app context; 「Edit app」 is `ghost` / `icon`, `h-8 w-8`, named by `aria-label` and `title`, same target and same `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-button"`. Below `sm` the compact title is unchanged, now fed by `objectRouteTitle`.
3. **The crumb render drops its link and menu arms: RIGHT.** `BreadcrumbItem` in `@object-ui/types` is untouched. At the head no surviving branch (dashboard, page, report, `system/*`) pushes an `href` or `siblings`, so plain text loses nothing on those routes. The one behaviour that left with the record crumb is the one-click jump to a grandparent in a related-record trail; `RecordDetailView`'s parent back link remains, each parent carrying the trail above it, and the changeset says so.
4. **A DOM hook goes: RIGHT, and named.** `data-testid="app-design-in-studio-label"` is removed with the text span. It is in no `exports` map and is no prop; its one in-tree reader was the objectui#12201 pin, rewritten here; the sibling checkout has none.
5. **`RecordDetailView`: one comment, RIGHT.** No code moves; the old sentence would have been false after this diff. Outside the claim's file surface, accepted for that reason.
6. **Tests: RIGHT.** New `AppHeader.appBarLeftGroup-12461` (ten cells; three ablation legs, each red on its own pin, restore proven blob-equal to HEAD), and the 12201, 12273, 11696 and 11295 pins rewritten to the new behaviour with docblocks naming objectui#12461. The card's "no element whose text is the current object's label" is read as "none a desktop-width bar shows", `sm:hidden` excluded, which is the card's own "below `sm` the bar is as today".

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/12461-app-bar-left-group.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor; `@object-ui/i18n` minor with a BREAKING paragraph naming the key, the absence of a replacement and what a host gets back. **RIGHT.** objectui ships its own breaking changes as `minor` with the break stated and never `major` (AGENTS.md §9, mechanised by `check-changeset-no-major`); `minor` for app-shell is what the card's acceptance asks for; the migration text is present (no replacement, the sidebar and the view strip are the destinations). `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are green on the head.
- **The `Clause-②:` line: WRONG.** Line 2 of the PR body reads `Clause-②: no`, the dispatch claim's value copied verbatim before any pack key moved. The diff narrows a published accept set and its own changeset says BREAKING; an absent arm declares no direction, and `no (narrowing)` is the spelling that exists for exactly this case: not a widening, and breaking. The right line is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, as PR objectui#12279 wrote for the same kind of retirement. The dev flagged this in the report and left line 2 to the seat.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations, each answered:
- Narrowing against the dispatch's `Clause-②` stop line: kept (open question 3 below); the line carries the arm (②).
- `@object-ui/i18n` minor with a BREAKING note: right (②).
- `RecordDetailView` comment outside the claim's surface: accepted; the seat may add the file to the claim's surface.
- Four pins rewritten: right (① item 6).
- First ablation pass refused as a no-op and re-run: reported, nothing hidden.

- Commit trailer in objectui's model-free pair: right.

`open_questions`, each answered or escalated:
1. Dashboard, page and report crumbs. **A, keep them for this card.** The card's title and build list name the object crumb; those three crumbs carry the maintainer's ruling on cloud#2768 (objectui#12198, objectui#12273), and a page route would be left with no on-screen name. B is a product call: **escalated** to the maintainer on objectui#12444's thread, not on this PR.
2. The search is not centered on `main`. The card's item 3 is a false premise, measured on the base: a `justify-between` root with the search first in the right-hand `shrink-0` cluster. **A, escalated**: a child card under objectui#12444 scoped to app context, filed on the maintainer's word; right not to build it here, since the root is shared with the variants the card fences out.
3. Keep the `topbar.switchObject` retirement. **A, keep.** The key's one reader is gone, no reader remains in this tree or in the sibling, and `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only, so a reverted key would sit unflagged; the precedent did the same. With the arm on line 2.

Flags this review raises:
- **`main` moved on the same file.** Since the base `cf430cd10`, objectui#12429 landed as `e869e41275` (the sidebar trigger, in `AppHeader.tsx`) and objectui#12442 as `3e2394d761`; the PR reads `behind`. A `git merge-tree` of `origin/main` and this head, which touches neither index nor working tree, is clean, but the card's serial constraint says the second to land merges `main` again (a merge commit, never a rebase), and a clean merge is not a working merge: the dev merges `origin/main`, runs the `AppHeader` suites with the 12429 and 12461 pins together, and pushes. That moves the head, so the record for landing is written on the merged head, in-seat at this tier.
- **`Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on the head, and does not count against this PR.** Signature from the head run's annotations: failing step `pnpm run type-check` in `packages/types` exited 2; first error `TS2430: Interface 'PageNodeSchema' incorrectly extends interface 'Omit…'`, attributed to `packages/types/src/layout.ts`, compiled against objectstack spec@main `c7dd48ab4c12`. The merge-base `cf430cd10` carries the same signature (same step, same first error, same file, against spec@main `c5dd7fce3038`), the gate's scheduled run on `main` at `cf430cd10` is red with it, and the five other pull-request runs of the last hour are red with it; this PR touches no file under `packages/types`. That is objectstack drift: a main-red for the `domain:devx` lane by the workflow's own header, which also says the context left the merge queue's required set (objectui#12240); whether the ruleset agrees is `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`'s reading, not this record's. Every other check on the head is green at the reading above.
